lotInfo:
Arjo Opera mobile patient lift. Floor‑standing powered transfer device designed for assisted lifting and repositioning of non‑ambulatory patients. Unit includes main mast, wheeled base, articulating boom, spreader bar/cradle assembly, and control housing. Lift shows wear consistent with extended institutional use. Battery is not included, and operational status is unknown. Functional components may require testing, servicing, or replacement. Cosmetic condition may include scratches, scuffs, chipped paint, or other signs of prior utilization.

Item is designated repairable/salvage, appropriate for refurbishment, parts recovery, or technical evaluation by qualified service personnel. No accessories, sling, charger, or documentation are confirmed to be included. Offered as-is, not certified for patient care without proper inspection and reconditioning.

ARJO Opera Patient Lift, EE#126251.
